en.backupSchedule.title: Scheduled backup · {0}
en.backupSchedule.description: Automatically packages the whole instance directory into a tar.gz snapshot at the scheduled time (instances that are not running are backed up as usual; running ones flush with save-off/save-all before packing). Schedules run on the Agent and keep working while the panel is closed.
en.backupSchedule.enable.label: Enable scheduled backup
en.backupSchedule.enable.desc: When off, no automatic backups; existing and manual backups are not affected
en.backupSchedule.keepCount.hint: Keep count · oldest backups are cleaned up automatically after each successful backup (0 = unlimited, manual and automatic backups count together)
en.backupSchedule.list.title: Backup schedules
en.backupSchedule.empty: No backup schedules yet (e.g. auto-backup the world every day at 4 AM)
en.autoRestart.title: Auto restart · {0}
en.autoRestart.description: Restart automatically after crashes and on a schedule. Only effective while the Agent is online; manual stops (or a console stop) are not auto-restarted.
en.autoRestart.autoRestart.label: Restart after crash
en.autoRestart.autoRestart.desc: Starts automatically when the process exits abnormally (not a manual stop, non-zero exit code)
en.autoRestart.delay.hint: Delay before restart (seconds) · consecutive crashes back off automatically, up to 60 seconds
en.autoRestart.list.title: Scheduled restarts
en.autoRestart.empty: No scheduled tasks yet (e.g. restart automatically every day at 4 AM to ease memory fragmentation and lag)

en.backup.description: Backs up the instance as a full tar.gz snapshot, stored in .backups next to the instance directory on the server. Restoring overwrites all current instance files (a running instance is force-stopped first).
